route_request.purpose: Classify the current skill-framework request into authoring, validation, runtime, or diagram rendering work before running any specialized branch.

recovery.strategy: Replay the current request summary and reroute only if the request meaning changed.

author.purpose: Handle skill creation, upgrade, and evolution requests without changing the routing or rendering branches.

recovery.strategy: Resume from the current authoring intent and continue using existing framework guidance and scripts.

validate.purpose: Handle skill validation requests using the existing deterministic validator scripts.

recovery.strategy: Resume from the validation target and continue with the matching validator scripts.

runtime.purpose: Handle skill runtime control requests using the existing skill runtime script and contracts.

recovery.strategy: Resume from the runtime operation and target run state without rerouting the request.

render_diagram.purpose: Render a whole-skill flow diagram as a standalone HTML page generated directly from the skill JSON specs.

recovery.strategy: Resume from the target skill and latest accepted render inputs, then regenerate the HTML artifact if the request or theme changed.

blocked.purpose: Stop when the request cannot be safely classified or completed because required inputs, scripts, or HTML-render dependencies are unavailable.

recovery.strategy: Resume only after the missing input, script prerequisite, or environment blocker is resolved.

done.purpose: Terminal state after the requested capability branch completes.
